ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolio
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by forward discount, buy the highest-interest-rate basket, and sell the lowest-interest-rate basket.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.
ideas.mechanism: Currency carry based on forward discounts and interest-rate differentials.

rules.market: Currencies against USD; the paper also examines a developed-country currency sample.
rules.entry: At month-end, rank currencies by forward discount; go long the highest-ranked portfolio and short the lowest-ranked portfolio.
rules.exit: Rebalance at the end of each month.

ideas.claimed_result: For the full currency sample from November 1983 to December 2009, the paper reports an annualized high-minus-low excess return of 8.53% before bid-ask spreads and 4.54% after bid-ask spreads.
